contentHtml: Our seminar studies empirical international macroeconomics using (mostly time series) econometrics. Topics include, but not limited to, analyzing exchange rate dynamics, forecasting future exchange rates, understanding international business cycles, and writing a clear report on current economic conditions. In order to deal with economic data, we will learn how to use computer software such as MATLAB and Stata.
